properties.site-address: Land around and including Malvins House Close, Blyth
properties.notes: Cleared site within an established residential area. A previous permission for 48 units on part of the site has now lapsed (10/S/00290/VARYCO). This scheme comprised of 33 flats, 9 terraced houses, 4 detached houses and 2 bungalows. This extended the time limit of original application (06/00225/FUL). The site is still considered developable in the longer term as a chance for urban infill, with the high density identified considered to reflect the setting and likely proposals for an apartment/flatted scheme.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
